about: X.W11.hld (COHESION §0gx.1): THE ONE committed manifest of producer-held e2e failures, the form §0ew ruled for fourier. Each row is one exact leg whose cure is glass-ui's to ship: an O-id glass has acknowledged with a placed vehicle, a measured producer cause, and an expiry at that repin. A row with a consumer arm cannot be admitted. e2e/honest-red-reporter.ts reads this file: only reds not named here, or red without their token, fail the job; a held row reading GREEN prints an adoption notice. Each test stays real and red, with no test.fail() and no skip. A row leaves by adoption.

rows.row: R11 NO-REPAINT-AFTER-RESTORE: a parked <Blob> stays blank after webglcontextlost then webglcontextrestored
rows.cause: On SwiftShader the parked renderer schedules no redraw on restore: the draw count stays at 2 against > 2 ('no repaint after restore', CI job 124177322852, three attempts). The cure is the producer's one-redraw law; §0gu.6 refuses a consumer un-park.

rows.row: TIER-PROBE-SYNC-LOSECONTEXT: the render-tier probe blocks the main thread on a synchronous loseContext after a reload
rows.cause: After page.reload on a software GPU process, the reload-to-expandDock span took 13273 ms, 12792 ms of it self time in loseContext behind the previous document's context teardown (docker-o21f.json). value.js asks once per page and the css answer constructs no Aurora runtime, so runtime.ts:252 is not reached there.
